entries.text:
Today's session — 60 minutes of easy jogging:

Today's 60-minute easy jog is your planned session, and it's a perfect chance to let your body move without pressure. Use this time to settle into a comfortable rhythm and enjoy the fresh air. Show up for yourself and get it done—you'll feel better for having started.
